pages.title: Notice inviting tender
pages.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT A LIVE TENDER
Tender reference: SYNTHETIC / TL-IN / 2026 / 001
Project: Campus network upgrade at a fictional training campus in India.

1. Scope
Supply, installation and commissioning of network equipment listed in the Bill of Quantities. Delivery location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

2. Critical dates
Original bid submission deadline: 20 October 2026 at 15:00 IST.
Technical bid opening: 21 October 2026 at 11:00 IST.
Clarification questions must be submitted by 10 October 2026 at 17:00 IST.
Check all supplied corrigenda before relying on these dates.

3. Bid security and fee
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): INR 50,000 (fifty thousand rupees).
Tender processing fee: INR 1,000, non-refundable.
No EMD exemption is specified in this fictional package; an exemption must not be inferred from MSME registration.

4. Bid validity
The bid must remain valid for 90 days from the final submission deadline.

pages.title: Eligibility and submission checklist
pages.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT A LIVE TENDER

5. Financial eligibility
Average annual turnover of at least INR 25 lakh across FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26. Submit audited financial statements for all three financial years and a chartered accountant's turnover certificate.

6. Technical eligibility
At least two completed similar network installation contracts in the last three years, each with value of at least INR 10 lakh. Submit work orders and completion certificates.

7. Mandatory documents
Submit PAN, GST registration, signed bid form, EMD payment proof, turnover certificate, audited financial statements, completion certificates and manufacturer authorization.
Udyam registration may be included if available; it does not establish an EMD exemption under this package.

8. Commercial instructions
Quote prices in INR. State GST separately; the quoted base price must exclude GST. No GST percentage is prescribed in this package.
Do not include prices in the technical bid.

9. Delivery and warranty
Delivery and commissioning within 45 days of the purchase order. Minimum on-site warranty: three years.

pages.title: Corrigendum 01 - dates only
pages.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT A LIVE TENDER
Tender reference: SYNTHETIC / TL-IN / 2026 / 001
Issued: 8 October 2026 (fictional scenario)

This corrigendum amends only clause 2 (Critical dates) of 01_Demo_Notice_and_Eligibility.pdf.
The bid submission deadline is extended from 20 October 2026 at 15:00 IST to 27 October 2026 at 15:00 IST.
The technical bid opening is revised to 28 October 2026 at 11:00 IST.
The clarification deadline remains 10 October 2026 at 17:00 IST.

All other clauses, eligibility requirements, quantities, EMD and fee remain unchanged.
This synthetic future-dated amendment exists solely to exercise document precedence in the demo. It is not a real notice.
